Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products, a scheme that refunds embedded taxes on exports through transferable duty credits. It is claimed on the shipping bill, so it must be declared correctly at the time of export.
What is the difference between Advance Authorisation and EPCG?
Advance Authorisation lets you import inputs used to make export goods without duty. EPCG lets you import capital goods, such as machinery, at zero duty against a future export obligation.
Do I need BIS certification to import electronics?
Many electronic and IT products need BIS registration before they can be imported and sold in India. We check your product's status before you place the order.
Can you help with a customs notice?
Yes. We prepare replies to queries and show-cause notices and support you through hearings with the facts and the right legal provisions.
